mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions at Verona City Hall show 70 degrees with overcast skies and a waning gibbous moon phase.

In city news, the Verona Police Department is ready to assist with your records requests online through crashdocs.org, and the public works department has announced road surface treatments scheduled for August 4 through 7.

We have a busy weekend ahead, starting with the Remote Area Medical clinic today at Verona Area High School and live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, followed by yoga classes at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
Looking at the weekly police report, one noteworthy call occurred on July 23 when officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Lucerne Drive which resulted in an arrest.
Culver's of Verona is serving up OREO Cookie Cheesecake today until 10 PM, and if you are looking for more frozen treats, Kona Ice will be at Fireman's Park today from 1:30 PM to 3:15 PM.
